formulas.definition: Generalized (floating-mean) Lomb-Scargle per number on calendar days; freq grid k/8000 (k=1..4000) + 1/7,2/7,3/7 cycles/day, admissible f>=1/span; ridge lam=1e-3; dominant f = argmax explained-variance power on past draws only; score = fitted sinusoid at the target date; top 7.
formulas.formula_text: score_i = Y_i + b_i(f*)[cos(2pi f* tau)-C] + c_i(f*)[sin(2pi f* tau)-S],  f*_i = argmax_f P_i(f) on past

formulas.definition: Kalman local-level per number: x=mu+eps (R=p0(1-p0)), mu random walk (Q=qR), mu0=p0, P0=(0.1p0)^2; q in {0,1e-6,3e-6,1e-5,3e-5,1e-4,3e-4,1e-3,3e-3,1e-2} by pooled prediction-error log-likelihood on past draws; score = one-step predicted propensity; top 7.
formulas.formula_text: score_i = mu_i(t|t-1; q_hat),  q_hat = argmax_q sum_j sum_i log N(v_ij; 0, P_j+R)

formulas.definition: Pooled multi-segment Burg (max-entropy) AR on the 22 centered indicator series, orders 0..14, order by AIC n ln sigma2_m + 2m (n=22t); score = own past mean + AR one-step forecast; top 11.
formulas.formula_text: score_i = xbar_i - sum_{k<=m_hat} a_k (x_i(t-k) - xbar_i),  a = Burg PEF, m_hat = argmin AIC
